summary: Marex Group plc (Nasdaq: MRX) filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release. The release reported record quarterly revenue of $692.3M (+48% YoY), adjusted PBT of $152.7M (+59%), and basic EPS of $1.52 (+55%). The filing also noted strategic updates: sale of Winterflood custody business (expected $40M capital benefit in Q2 2026), a successful USD senior unsecured debt issuance, and a proposed redomiciling to Bermuda (shareholder vote May 21, 2026; implementation H2 2026). The increased quarterly dividend to $0.16/share was announced. This is a routine earnings update with no change of control, activist campaign, or transaction triggering a special-situation category beyond an ordinary corporate update.
